### Ready for Black Belt: Systems & Bridges

Once all Brown Belt checks pass and your Evidence Log trends toward proposal asks, stated purposes, and real disclosures in both dojos, carry your **Linguistic Script-Book**, **Bilingual Lexicon (Br3)**, **Reveal Ladder (Br4)**, and **Steering Map (Br5)** directly into Black Belt—where **Bk1** zooms out from individual conversations to the culture of the room, **Bk2** brokers your proposals across tribes, and **Bk3** scales your Br3 translation-tax awareness into a grounded bridge self.
